name: Notion
whatYouLose: Real-time multiplayer editing at global scale
A vast block ecosystem, databases and formulas
Offline sync, mature mobile apps and enterprise controls
prompt: Build a focused team wiki and project notebook. Support nested pages, markdown shortcuts, slash commands for a small set of blocks, full-text search, backlinks, page history, comments, permissions for owner/editor/viewer, public share links and export to Markdown. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript and SQLite. Use optimistic editing with conflict detection rather than attempting Google-Docs-style live collaboration.
notes: A useful wiki is very buildable. A universal workspace with multiplayer databases, mobile apps and flawless sync is not a one-prompt weekend.
